$comment: SOURCE, NOT GENERATED. A release entry read section by section: a title, a sentence, the drawings it added, the drawings it redrew, then the next section, instead of the whole note first and every tile after it (Zafar, 17 Sep 2026: "topic > icons, topic > icons. not all topics first and then all icons after that", then "categorize them, not just text > icons. titles, etc."). Sections follow the site's shelves, titled as the category rail titles them, with an announcement that has nothing to tile (the four styles) as a section of its own. Keyed by the version the work ships as, like lib/icon-release-order.json, so nothing needs re-keying when the tag is cut. `names` are drawings the release added and `redraws` are drawings it redrew; pipeline/build-history.mjs keeps only the ones the entry actually carries, and anything no section claims is appended in a last untitled group and reported, so a stale list can never drop a drawing. Numbers go in as {names} and {files}. Where a version has sections, every surface prints them in place of the note.

1.0.0.title: Four styles
1.0.0.text: Every name now comes in stroke, two-tone, duotone and fill: {files} SVGs across {names} names. The outlined duotone is called two-tone from this release, so an import of duotone that wants the old look changes to two-tone. Duotone is a new style with no outline, a grey body with the part that matters in black, drawn icon by icon.

1.0.0.title: People
1.0.0.text: A new shelf for the boy, the girl, a baby with a curl, one with a bow, and both babies again with a pacifier.

1.0.0.title: Layout
1.0.0.text: The panels gain their close, open and dashed forms on every side, three split layouts and a table. The four dashed close panels sit their grey under the frame's round corners, and the grid fills keep 2 units clear of their edges.

1.0.0.title: Devices
1.0.0.text: The phone takes call, incoming, outgoing, missed and forwarded. The tablet takes its upright form and the phone's eight signs, a laptop arrives, and the tablet and the laptop each sit beside a phone. In two-tone scan-eye greys its frame, and scan-search's handle starts on its ring.

1.0.0.title: Finance
1.0.0.text: Two banknotes carry a check, minus, plus and x, and the coins sit on rounder faces with 2 units between every coin.

1.0.0.title: Time
1.0.0.text: The alarm clock takes a check, plus and minus, beside a stopwatch and its reset.

1.0.0.title: Transport
1.0.0.text: A rocket climbs on its flame, trails speed lines and stands upright.

1.0.0.title: Pointers
1.0.0.text: A hand closes and opens, and the pointer is drawn again in all four directions.

1.0.0.title: Arrows
1.0.0.text: The big arrows point four ways.

1.0.0.title: Text
1.0.0.text: The heading comes with its six levels.

1.0.0.title: Files
1.0.0.text: A zipped folder, and the file fills cut their folded corner clear of the edge.

1.0.0.title: Charts
1.0.0.text: In two-tone the charts grey their axes and keep the data in black.

1.0.0.title: Media
1.0.0.text: The gallery frames take a tighter radius, and play is smaller.

1.0.0.title: Shapes
1.0.0.text: In two-tone circle-progress-play greys the part still to play.

1.0.0.title: Web
1.0.0.text: In two-tone globe-off greys its far side.
